title: EAM/Facets Member Eligibility Validation - keyword file
description: Validates a member referenced by a pending keyword file against the eam and facets Postgres tables before the member's record is allowed to proceed to input/ for downstream processing. This job is diagnosed entirely from the keyword bucket's error/ prefix and two Postgres tables, not CloudWatch.
match_rule: For every object present in the keyword bucket's error/ prefix (s3://test-0v1-ioonh/error/), parse it as one or more comma-separated @FIELD="VALUE" records per line (e.g. RECTYPE="MEMD" detail lines mixed with RECTYPE="MEME" member lines). Only RECTYPE="MEME" lines carry @pMEME_HEALTH_ID, so a single file may reference multiple members - process each one found. pMEME_HEALTH_ID corresponds to memberID in the eam table and to mem_health_id in the facets table - the same identifier, two column names. A member is ELIGIBLE only when ALL of the following hold: (1) a row exists in eam with member_id = pMEME_HEALTH_ID, (2) a row exists in facets with mem_health_id = pMEME_HEALTH_ID, (3) the eam row has has_active=true, planname in ('MA','MAPD'), confirmation_letter_went=true, member_exist_in_eam=true, welcome_kit_triggered=true, id_card_triggered=true, pcp_letter_went=true, and effective_date <= today <= term_date, and (4) the facets row independently passes that SAME set of checks. If any condition fails, print a console message identifying which check(s) failed and skip the member. If eligible, take the member's HIC from the facets row.

example_log_events.description: Eligible member - all eam and facets checks pass
example_log_events.raw_event:
kwd file content: @RECTYPE="MEME",@pMEMD_UPDATE_CD="AP",@pMEME_REL="M",@pMEME_HEALTH_ID="M1001"
eam row: has_active=true planname=MA confirmation_letter_went=true member_exist_in_eam=true welcome_kit_triggered=true id_card_triggered=true pcp_letter_went=true effective_date=2026-08-23 term_date=9999-12-31
facets row: hic=1A2B3C4D5E6 (same checks, all pass)
example_log_events.why: Both the eam and facets records for M1001 independently pass every required check and both dates are currently valid, so the member's HIC is exported to a new input/EAF_<timestamp>.txt file for this source kwd file.

example_log_events.raw_event:
kwd file content: @RECTYPE="MEME",@pMEMD_UPDATE_CD="AP",@pMEME_REL="M",@pMEME_HEALTH_ID="M1002"
eam row: has_active=false confirmation_letter_went=false welcome_kit_triggered=false id_card_triggered=false
example_log_events.why: The eam row for M1002 fails multiple required checks (has_active, confirmation_letter_went, welcome_kit_triggered, id_card_triggered all false), so the member is not exported and a console message names the failed checks.

decision_tree.name: Look up the member referenced by the keyword file in both eam and facets
decision_tree.instruction: Extract pMEME_HEALTH_ID from the keyword file. Query eam.member_id and facets.mem_health_id for a matching row in each table.

conditions.if: no matching row exists in eam OR no matching row exists in facets
conditions.note: Member not found in one or both tables - print which table(s) had no match, skip this member.

conditions.if: a matching row exists in BOTH eam and facets
conditions.note: Proceed to step 2 to check the eligibility flags/dates on both rows.

decision_tree.name: Validate eligibility flags and date validity on both records
decision_tree.instruction: On EACH of the eam row and the facets row independently, check: has_active=true, planname in ('MA','MAPD'), confirmation_letter_went=true, member_exist_in_eam=true, welcome_kit_triggered=true, id_card_triggered=true, pcp_letter_went=true, and effective_date <= today <= term_date (not yet termed).

conditions.if: ANY check fails on the eam row OR ANY check fails on the facets row
conditions.note: Print a console message listing exactly which check(s) failed on which table(s); do not export this member.

conditions.if: ALL checks pass on BOTH the eam row and the facets row
conditions.note: Take the HIC from the facets row and add it to that source kwd file's own EAF_<timestamp>.txt output object (in the keyword bucket's input/ prefix) as a single-quoted value, comma-separated with any other eligible members from the SAME source file.

feedback_notes: Fully deterministic (no LLM judgment involved) once triggered: implemented in jobs/process_eam_member_kwd_files.py, common/eam_facets_store.py, and common/member_eligibility.py. Reads s3://test-0v1-ioonh/error/* - EACH source kwd file gets its OWN output object at s3://test-0v1-ioonh/input/EAF_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.txt (output_filename field is a filename PREFIX, not a full name), not one combined file. Does not move or delete the source keyword files. Two ways to trigger it: (1) directly - `python -m jobs.process_eam_member_kwd_files`, or continuously via `--watch`; (2) through a matching ServiceNow incident - the Job Remediation Agent keyword-matches this SOP from ticket text, and common/remediation_executor.py's export_eligible_member_hic/flag_member_ineligible handlers re-run this exact job (not LLM-improvised) when either action is recommended and passes guardrails. Not yet auto-triggered on S3 object-create - no event notification is configured on the bucket.
